dashboard.label: Executive Security KPI Program — Overview
dashboard.description: Landing page for the executive security KPI program. Choose a persona view below; each dashboard shares the same underlying data model, so drilling down from any KPI eventually lands on the same raw incident/alert/vulnerability/transaction record.

panel.title: Enterprise Financial Impact of Security Incidents (last 12 months)

search.query: | inputlookup security_incidents.csv | stats sum(financial_impact_usd) as total_impact
| inputlookup fraud_transactions.csv | where is_fraud="Y" | eval net_loss=loss_amount_usd-recovered_amount_usd | stats sum(net_loss) as net_loss
| inputlookup uptime_availability.csv | stats avg(uptime_pct) as avg_uptime | eval avg_uptime=round(avg_uptime,3)
| inputlookup vulnerability_scans.csv | where (severity="Critical" OR severity="High") AND patch_status!="Patched" | stats count as open_vulns

td.p: Risk score, material incidents, customer trust, regulatory standing.
Fraud loss, spend vs. loss avoided, regulatory fine exposure, insurance.
Availability vs. SLA, MTTD/MTTR, incident backlog, vendor ops risk.
Vulnerability management, SOC triage, patch compliance, MITRE ATT&CK.

html.h3: How the drill-down works across all four dashboards
html.p: Every dashboard follows the same five-layer pattern, so any executive can start at their KPI and land on the exact same ground truth:

ol.li: Board KPI — a single aggregated number (risk score, fraud loss, availability %, open vulnerabilities).
Business Unit — click the KPI's breakdown chart to filter to one of 7 business units (Retail Banking, Payments & Cards, Digital Banking, etc.).
System / Channel / Asset — click again to narrow to the specific application, channel, or vendor.
Event record — the underlying incident, flagged transaction, vulnerability scan, or SOC alert row.

Cross-dashboard join — business_unit and system are shared keys across all 8 datasets, so a CEO-level incident can be traced to the CIO's SOC alert and vulnerability scan that caused it, or the CFO's fraud loss it produced.
